ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve IS
 chp_sysdate DATE;

 procedure change_status is
 begin
 set_item_property('donations.pb_audit',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_drive_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_unit_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_sort_coll',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_user_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_insert_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_donor_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_don_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_proc_sort',ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 end change_status;

BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate);
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 go_block('donations');
 set_block_property('donations',update_allowed,property_true);

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_status='R' then
 select nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations
 where drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)
 and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,chp_sysdate-25) 
 and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,chp_sysdate)
 and unit_id is not null and donor_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25)and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and unit_id is not null and donor_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id');

 elsif :ctrl_blk_1.s_status='N' then

 select nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations
 where drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)
 and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,chp_sysdate)
 and unit_id is not null and donor_id is null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 


 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and unit_id is not null and donor_id is null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id');
 else

 select nvl(count(*),0) into :ctrl_blk_1.c_query_count from donations
 where drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)
 and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,chp_sysdate)
 and unit_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 
 set_block_property('donations',default_where ,
 ' drive_id= nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_drive_id,drive_id)' ||
 ' and coll_date between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-25) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate)'||
 ' and unit_id is not null and n_audit_flag is null and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id');
 end if;

 set_application_property(cursor_style,'busy');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 set_application_property(cursor_style,'default');
 set_block_property('donations',update_allowed,property_false);

 if :donations.unit_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date');
 else
 enable_disable('D');
 change_status; 
 end if;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: CALL_WINDOW_PROGRAM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE call_window_program (p_window_name varchar2) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 pl_name VARCHAR2(10) := 'dondata'; 
BEGIN 

 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF not Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 destroy_parameter_list(pl_id);
 end if;
 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List(pl_name); 
 IF Id_Null(pl_id) THEN
 Message('Error creating parameter list '||pl_name); 
 RAISE Form_Trigger_Failure; 
 END IF;

 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_donor_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.donor_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_trans_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.transaction_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_unit_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :donations.dummy_unit_id);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_chapter_id', TEXT_PARAMETER, :global.chapter_id); 
 /* modified and verified for Y2k..........Sobha........06/07/99 */

 if p_window_name='DRWHOLDS' then
 Add_Parameter(pl_id, 'p_coll_date', TEXT_PARAMETER, to_char(:donations.coll_date,'mm-dd-yyyy')); 
 end if;

 
 call_form( lower(p_window_name) ,NO_HIDE ,NO_REPLACE ,NO_QUERY_ONLY ,pl_id);
END;

RecordGroup.Name: RG_DRIVES
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery:
select a.drive_id,to_char(a.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy') drive_dte,c.name from drives a,drive_sponsors b,sponsors c where b.drive_id=a.drive_id and trunc(a.drive_date) between nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_from_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate-30) and nvl(:ctrl_blk_1.s_to_date,:ctrl_blk_1.s_chp_sysdate) and c.sponsor_id=b.sponsor_id 
and a.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
and a.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 order by to_date(to_char(a.drive_date,'mm-dd-yyyy'),'mm-dd-yyyy') desc,a.drive_id
/* modified and verified for Y2k..........Sobha........06/07/99 */

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;
